description: Implementation of LocalizationService class for managing localization, formatting, and resource handling in a Windows app, including singleton pattern, font management, locale-aware formatting, and string processing for accessibility.

classes.name: LocalizationService
classes.description: Singleton class providing localization, font, and formatting services for the application.

methods.name: GetInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of LocalizationService, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: OverrideWithLanguage
methods.description: Overrides the singleton instance with a specified language, mainly for testing.

methods.name: LocalizationService
methods.description: Constructor initializing localization settings based on system or overridden language.

methods.name: ParseFontWeight
methods.description: Parses a string to a FontWeight enum value.

methods.name: GetFlowDirection
methods.description: Returns the text flow direction based on layout.

methods.name: IsRtlLayout
methods.description: Checks if the layout is right-to-left.

methods.name: GetLanguage
methods.description: Returns the current language code.

methods.name: GetOverrideFontApiValues
methods.description: Indicates if font override values are used.

methods.name: GetLanguageFontFamilyForType
methods.description: Returns the font family for a given font type, considering overrides.

methods.name: GetLanguageFont
methods.description: Returns font details for a given font type.

methods.name: GetFontFamilyOverride
methods.description: Returns the font family override string.

methods.name: GetFontWeightOverride
methods.description: Returns the font weight override.

methods.name: GetFontScaleFactorOverride
methods.description: Returns the font scale factor override for a given font type.

methods.name: OnFontTypePropertyChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to font type property.

methods.name: OnFontWeightPropertyChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to font weight property.

methods.name: OnFontSizePropertyChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to font size property.

methods.name: UpdateFontFamilyAndSize
methods.description: Updates font family and size of a UI element based on current localization settings.

methods.name: GetRegionalSettingsAwareDecimalFormatter
methods.description: Returns a decimal formatter respecting user regional settings.

methods.name: GetRegionalSettingsAwareDateTimeFormatter
methods.description: Returns a DateTime formatter with 24-hour clock respecting regional settings.

methods.name: GetRegionalSettingsAwareDateTimeFormatter
methods.description: Returns a DateTime formatter with specified format, calendar, and clock, respecting regional settings.

methods.name: GetRegionalSettingsAwareCurrencyFormatter
methods.description: Returns a currency formatter respecting regional settings and user currency.

methods.name: GetLanguageIdentifiers
methods.description: Retrieves the list of language identifiers, considering overrides and locale validation.

methods.name: GetTokenToReadableNameMap
methods.description: Builds a map from engine resource keys to human-readable names for tokens.

methods.name: GetNarratorReadableToken
methods.description: Returns a human-readable token string for narration, appending parentheses if needed.

methods.name: GetNarratorReadableString
methods.description: Converts a string into a narratable, readable string by processing each token.

methods.name: Sort
methods.description: Sorts a vector of strings according to locale collation.
